notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]🕺 Hello Disco Fans! 💃[/b][/h1]

Recently we’ve announced the upcoming MAJOR CHANGES. As you can remember, we’ve promised you a bunch of new content: CCTV, events marketing, energy supply changes and more. 

[h2]We’re happy to announce that patch 1.2 is now live on Steam and these are all the changes! 🤩[/h2]



[h3][b]What's new:[/b][/h3]

[b]Night events[/b]
Every night will be packed with action! Be prepared because anything can happen and you’ll have to make tough calls in a blink of an eye! ⚠️

[b]Marketing events[/b]
Make sure that every single night your club is full of people. Gain recognition and spread the word about your mind blowing parties with the new event marketing system! 📣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6594d91ad70d8b3406568509183a6496dccbcd72.png[/img]


[b]Dancers and dance stations[/b]
Sometimes all it takes is a spark to fill the dancefloor with guests! The new employee- dancer will show them the best moves using the new object- dance station! 💃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/94d5224505222fa53a1de2d32e57a81eb83496ad.gif[/img]

[b]Slot machines[/b]
A little activity for all the party people who need a moment of rest. Slot machines- arcades known all around the world will undoubtedly make for a good additional activity in your clubs! 🎮

[b]CCTV[/b]
With addition of the brand new CCTV system making sure that all the troublemakers will leave the club immediately has never been easier! 📹

[b]Energy[/b]
The last bill for the energy left you speechless? You look for some way to spend less money? Check out the new energy management system where you can see and adjust how much power all the decorations and appliances need! 💡

[b]Bar supply[/b]
A gentleman themed bar? A beer party? Any theme is now available for you. Manage the stock of alcohol available at the bar to make it match the party even more! 🍷 (Keep in mind that some guests may not like it when your bar is short of some particular drink)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/589561b49b1c7f23e1953bbd128df6d2d6927a2f.png[/img]





[h2][b]Full List of changes:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 8 night events with diffrent decitions and results
[*] Added marketing options in events schedule panel
[*] Added new cathegories:
- Bar storage in build panel which increases supply capaciy
-  Energy in build panel which increases energy capaciy
- Dance stations in build panel
- CCTV in equipment panel
-  Slot machines in equipment panel
[*] Added dancer as a new employee to hire in Employees panel
[*] Added new upgrades:
- Slot machines in "Good Disco" upgrade
-  CCTV in "Advanced employees" upgrade
- Dancers and dance stations in "Professional employee stations" upgrade
- Bar storage in "Standard bar equipment" upgrade
- Energy storage in "Stylish and fancy decorations" upgrades
[*] Updated club management panel:
-  Added energy cost
- Added bar supply cost
- Added section for buying bar supplies
[*] Added new statistics to night summary panel:
- Money spend on bar supplies
- Money spend on energy
- Money earned by dancers
- Money earned on slot machines
[*] Added warning panel that during the day reminds of low supply or exceeded energy
[*] Added new item popups:
- energy - when energy capacity is exceeded
- bar supply - when there are no supplies
[*] Added new clients animations
[*] Increased number of songs that can be loaded
[/list]


[h3][b]Bug Fixes and ballance changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased alcohol prices in upgrades
[*] Grid no longer shows during the night in specific conditions
[*] Fixed prices and decoration potins for "Gijava" and "Jukjogli" speakers
[*] Disabled speakers particles while broken
[*] Fixed few clipping bugs
[*] Fixed a bug when sometimes light or laser was unable to move
[*]Fixed several german translations
[*]Increased base ticket price
[/list]


[h3]As you can see there’s a lot of new content for you to enjoy! We’re sure that these new features will make your parties and clubs even better! 😎
We’re grateful for all of your feedback and what you tell us does matter. This helps us know which aspects of the game should we work on so make sure to leave us your opinions on Steam or on our discord! 👇[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Disco Simulator Team

notes.title: HUGE content update announcement!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Disco Enjoyers! 👋[/b][/h1]

First of all, we’d like to thank everyone for your feedback! ❤️‍ Thank you all! Since the release of the game, the amount of ideas you gave us was simply mind blowing. [b]Influenced by your enthusiasm towards our game, we’d like to announce a huge content update![/b] 💪 The upcoming changes are bound to make the gameplay even more satisfying so without further ado, let’s take a look at what’s to come! 🤩

[h3][b]Night events ❗[/b][/h3]
Sometimes unexpected events can really catch you off guard and force you to take an immediate action out of your comfort zone. Are you prepared to face whatever the night brings? 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/84bf84bdaad9980bc5c738a840843775105a912a.png[/img]

[h3][b]New employee - Dancer 💃[/b][/h3]
A brand new employee available to hire in your clubs! Hire dancers to boost your economy and meet the expectations of even the most needy customers. Watch out, those girls know how to move! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/94d5224505222fa53a1de2d32e57a81eb83496ad.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Marketing events 📣[/b][/h3]
Your events went without an echo? The people weren’t interested in visiting the club for the performance of your favorite DJ? [b]With the new marketing tools you can make sure every single time the club will be FULL[/b]! 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/42667e4dcd80014326e2a57b68c1e74a69be8437.png[/img]

[h3][b]New items - Slot machines 🎮[/b][/h3]
Some people like to gamble, or simply play some arcade. With help of the new machines you’ll grab the attention of these guests as well! Make sure that your club has something to offer for everyone and you’ll make the money come your way! 💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/c89f1714ee1446287e267509ce1e5e629be704c5.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New items - CCTV 🖥️[/b][/h3]
People think they can allow themselves to do more than it’s appropriate as soon as no one watches. With the help of CCTV you’ll be able to catch the instigators of problems and decrease the overall amount of incidents to make it through peacefully every single night! 🕺

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/67fb8d8bfd22c38914034f7700d43a8f277799d4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Bar supply 🍷[/b][/h3]
A brand new branch to manage. 📝 You can manipulate your bar menu via supplies! Be careful not to run out of the booze in the middle of the night. It would be wise to offer a wider variety of alcohol to be able to meet everyone’s tastes. 🙂

[h3][b]Electricity ⚡[/b][/h3]
Neons, disco balls and tons of lighting… All of these do cost money so make sure not to overload your electricity supplies. Otherwise the bills will make even the toughest managers shed a tear. 😢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/bb5eadde36809176e7448e37aaff05039fbd7fe3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Are you hyped for the upcoming changes? Remember that the game is still developed and the final appearance of the features we have shown you may change 🤏 Would you like us to add some specific content? Or would you change something about the ones we described?

Make sure to let us know in the comments! 🤩[/b][/h3]

If you’d like to have more inside info and stay in touch with the latest information about the game we encourage you to [b]join our discord community[/b]! 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url]

See you at the dancefloor,
Disco Simulator Team

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re happy to see all of you in another devlog from Disco Simulator. 💃 To start things up, we’d love to share some great news with all of you. Our game has entered the final stage of production 🔥 and because of that, we’ve been spending a lot of our time on fixing any bugs we’ve found as well as introducing and improving quality of life aspects the game has to offer. 👍 

What’s more, we’ve introduced some features that you- our community suggested! Let’s take a closer look at them, shall we? 👀

[h3][b]Automatic assignment of employees to the incidents 📝[/b][/h3]
You’ve been mentioning that having to manually assign the employees each time there is something happening is annoying so we’ve come up and introduced the solution! We hope that the game will be more satisfying with this improvement! 🙂

[h3][b]LED walls, more colors of the furniture 🎨 [/b][/h3]
You’ve been pointing out that there are not enough customization elements in the game. We’ve added LED walls and more colors to make the first step in changing that! 

[h3][b]Animated dancefloors, lights and particles [/b][/h3]
To make your clubs more dynamic, you’ve been suggesting that there should be more animated objects in them. We totally agree and today we can show you the fruits of our work in that aspect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/de4408e0f5d64f5eeff15dc14803ebf085bd1dff.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/83adbabecbc10ad066c107c5205f9416b6e2679e.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Save system[/b][/h3] 
We’ve taken a closer look and fully introduced the save system to help you during your playthroughs. 

[h3][b]DJ Minigame 🎶[/b][/h3]
The last novelty we’d like to show you is the DJ Mingame. It’s a pretty cool and straightforward minigame where you have to put together matching soundtracks. 🎵

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/52d0e140ce28871099164b77a923db358596dbea.png[/img]
We can’t wait to hear your opinions on these additions to the game. Make sure to let us know on the discord 👇 and add the game to your wishlists on Steam to not miss any of the upcoming info!

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226970/Disco_Simulator/ 

See you soon,
Disco Simulator Team

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Disco Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re happy to have you back with us in the last devlog of 2023. 🔥 For this particular occasion we’ve prepared 5️⃣ exciting novelties! Let’s take a closer look! 🤩

[h3][b]Game advancement indicator 📈[/b][/h3]
We’ve added a tool to help you track your progress and have a hold on what improvements you’ll unlock next. The disco level indicator will help you tremendously, showing the overall advancement in your gameplay. 💃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/0fafb4d7e314ba0566a1ae621623328bf2dd8c38.png[/img]
[h3][b]Work assignments[/b][/h3]
To make the game’s UI more unified and at the same time give you even more freedom of managing your employees we’ve added a possibility to manually assign your employees to the individual jobs 📝 and merged the newly added menu with the already existing functionalities such as the line, selling/moving objects etc which resulted in the creation of a one versatile panel! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/3886a63676cfccad8139014c96adb18273db02ff.png[/img]
[h3][b]New minigame- the bouncer 🎫[/b][/h3]
This new minigame happens at the entrance to your clubs. It checks if you’re attentive to details as to succeed you have to check a few different information on the ticket and an ID. Confirm the name, surname, age, expiration date of the ID and the date and name of the club on the ticket to make sure only the correct people enter your parties! ✋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/9ddb088476a1cd91580fdf9fa504bdaaf24cc045.png[/img]
[h3][b]Achievements! 🏆[/b][/h3]
We’re aware that part of our community is into challenges and conquering different goals during the gameplay. 🏅 That’s why we’ve decided to introduce some Steam Challenges which will hopefully meet your expectations and help you enjoy the gameplay even more! 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/b17c29c9a174f160ec933a528a9ea88e16521428.png[/img]
[h3][b]AI optimization 🧠[/b][/h3]
Thanks to your suggestions we’ve realized some issues with the way your guests used to behave and finally we’ve finished introducing changes to their decisions, pathing and actions. From now on they’ll choose their way more efficiently, taking the distance from their destination into consideration. We’re currently procuring tests with large scale clubs with the amount of guests counting in hundreds to make sure everything works as intended! 🙂 Last but not least, we’ve also added the display of the end of the night summary. Please, take a look. 🔎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/d61e49fa43b3302f6c5ad993fb7353ba1d807784.png[/img]
That’s it for today, we’d like to wish all of you Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year. Don’t forget to join our discord community and add the game to your wishlists on Steam if you enjoy our work!

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226970/Disco_Simulator/ 
See you next year
Disco Simulator Team

notes.title: Maps
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

Thanks again for playing our prologue and sending us so many suggestions and feedback! 📝
After the last devlog and the release of the prologue version as well as some of the works on it, which you can read about 👉[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1226970/view/7132068756345171790]here[/url] 👈 , we have moved on with further work on the full version of Disco Simulator ⚒️
 
In the meantime, we have received many requests to create a save system in our game and messages full of worries that such a system may not be in the game at all 🙀

That's why we decided to start the devlog by talking about it!

The save system in the full version of Disco Simulator is already working and is being tested by us, as you can see in the following screenshot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/0201fcdd3e2cf777ccd2076ffb6cc5b3a8fda043.png[/img]
[h3]Your gameplay progress will be completely safe! 😀[/h3]

Let's smoothly move on to the next point of this devlog that we wanted to tell you about, which is the maps in the world of the game Disco Simulator 🗺️

After entering the game, several maps will be available to you on which you can build your club. Some maps will be larger and others will be smaller, which will require you to think about several issues: the location of individual rooms and the design inside the club.

You have to make sure that in a club built on a small area of the map, there is no squeeze caused by a lot of furniture and decorations, through which the guests of your club will not be able to dance! 🕺

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/4842d11dcf089dbf8acc7b948dd1380f5b08d347.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/2c1bf2c7019688be27de5f5e2ad9f403479a02a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/8860aa910f9279f632b2291bfb860e2da4e93a42.png[/img]
Currently, we have created 9 maps, which differ not only in the area available for development but also in additional individual characteristics, resulting from the location of the club in the city :)  A.o things, some maps will be dominated by guests focused mainly on dancing, while on others they will come to the club mainly to have a drink!

As you can see, we give you a lot of freedom in choosing a place to build your club, but also in deciding what type of clubbers you want to host.
It is possible that even more maps will appear, but we will keep you informed about it in the next updates 💪.



Let us know what you think of the maps we've described, because we're very curious about your opinion! 

As always, we invite you to our Discord, where you can talk to us directly, and to add our game to your Steam Wishlist to keep you up to date with all the latest news about Disco Simulator!

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img]][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226970/Disco_Simulator/

See you soon,
Disco Simulator Team

notes.title: Prologue Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear Players! 👋[/b][/h2]

[h3]First of all, we'd like to thank you very much for playing[b] Disco Simulator Prologue[/b]!  It was a very nice surprise for us that so many people played our game 🤯

Many of your suggestions will be taken into account during further work on the game, and in the meantime we decided to update the Prologue as well! [/h3]


After analising your feedback we decided to make some changes in clients AI to redirect their decisions more to DISCO than toilet. 🔀
Additionally clients now will prioritize critical needs.
To make game easier in the begining we increased starting amount of money 💰 and made minor adjustments in clients starting parameters to minimize
the chance of clients entering the club unhappy.
Also we added more music to the game and we created music types in music player as well as we increased the number of your songs that you can load.

Right now we are working on new maps, new minigames, new incidents as well as new furnitures and decorations. 
We are plannig to add more information for you in the game for example how many clients are expected to come to the club based of current reputation ❗


[b]We hope that the changes will allow you to enjoy the game even more than before! We're still open to all your requests, so feel free to share your feedback with us. [/b]



[h3]Changelog 🔍:[/h3]

General
[list]
[*] Added 14 New "Disco style" songs to the game
[*] Added music types: Chill, Disco and Rock in music player
[*] Increase number of songs that can be loaded to 30.
[*] Increased started money by $5000
[*] Fixed the bug in which the building grid stays visible in the night
[*] Fixes for music player that sometimes stopped autoplaying songs
[/list]

Clients
[list]
[*] Reduced the chance of using the toilet over other activities
[*] Increased the chance to dance over other activities
[*] Increased starting parameters to reduce the possibility of unhappy clients entering the club
[*] Eliminated the possibiity of using the toilet and ordering a drink with the parameter greater than 75%
[*] Added prioritising critical needs (when the parameter is lower than 20%)
[*] Reduced preparation time of drinks (reduced time depends on drink quality)
[/list]

[b]
Have a great day,

notes.title: New features!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Disco Enjoyers! 👋[/b][/h1]

With each released devlog, we’re doing our best to give you insight into the new content, ideas and features you’ll look forward to trying out yourself once the full version is released. 👀

[h3][b]We’ve been listening to your responses and suggestions for quite some time[/b] and there was one which was frequently coming back all the time. Today, the time has come. We are really pleased to announce we’ve implemented a solution that allows you to [b]upload your favorite songs to the game![/b] 🤩[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/a9da7e448abb906179a335acd313ef7e4914373f.png[/img]
In the menu a designated button will appear which will open the music uploading panel. The songs you wish to have in game [b](remember about the correct mp3, .wav format) [/b]can be uploaded to the game files. Thanks to this, you’ll be able to play and listen to all the songs you’d love to! 👍

[h3][b]On top of that, we’ve created a club upgrade system. You’ll be able to develop your club in 5 different areas:

- furniture
- bar
- disco
- employees
- decorations[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/9f8c6e6430608a192e1e5862580884bc09b188d4.png[/img]
In [b]the furniture[/b] category we’ve prepared new, more expensive pieces that award you with more decoration points and are more comfortable. 🛋️ This allows your guests to replenish their stamina at higher rate. 

[b]The bar [/b]allows you to unlock new bars and more exclusive alcohol to sell. 🍾

If you choose to level up [b]the disco[/b] branch you’ll be able to upgrade your scene, lighting and sound system. More events will also appear. 🔊

[b]The employees[/b] branch allows you to hire new, better staff members, send the already hired ones to training or meet their expectations with better quality staff rooms 🙂 

While [b]the decoration [/b]branch is tremendously upgrading all the visual aspects of your club. 🎊

[h3]We’ve also wondered [b]how we can make the experience more natural and engaging during the night[/b]. The solution we’ve come up with is [b]the system allowing the clients to express their needs.[/b] Everytime the client comes across an expectation they can’t fulfill, you’ll get notified.

[b]- there isn’t enough dancefloors or toilets
- they are tired and there isn’t a designated space for that 
- they’d like to have a drink
- overall happiness or discontent with the level of your services[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/dc200b0c8ee1082b7d98f1f51e710a96eb76ab24.png[/img]
[b]Keeping a close eye on those pop-ups will allow you to better organize your club[/b], add the elements that are required and most needed to satisfy your clients’ expectations and allow your club to grow steadily! 📝

With those three changes we do think that the gameplay will be even more enjoyable and satisfying to all of you but we’d love to hear your opinions on this matter! 🤩 [b]If you have any ideas, things you’d like to see us introduce to the game please share them with us on our discord 👇 or comment section! 💃 [/b]Don’t forget you can visit the Steam main page of our game and try out the demo version! While you’re there, please consider adding our game to your wishlists!

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226970/Disco_Simulator/

See you soon,
Disco Simulator Team

notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]Every day is a party day in the dancing clubs of Disco Sim. and Today we brought to you something awaited by all- [b]the events[/b]! 🤩 Without further ado,[b] let’s see what the devs prepared[/b] and what’s still in progress! 😍[/h3]

[h3]First of all, we’d like to show you something we’re currently working on- [b]the Club’s weekly schedule[/b] where you’ll be able to [b]add and manage all the events[/b] 📝 such as concerts, DJ parties and so on. They can be both, manually added by a player or ordered by the game itself![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/042ab1cc21782e0173ca3a9ce2f43fa3cfd3e5c0.png[/img]

[h3]The schedule has another function and that is to [b]add the thematic days[/b]! 🕺 Be it a New Year’s Eve party which is given to you by the system or something like the beer day which you could set up yourself, [b]use them wisely to ramp up your club’s earnings[/b]! 💰[/h3]

[h2]Remember though, [b]when choosing the events 🎉 you’ll have to meet the requirements[/b]. Every event possible to choose will provide you with information about both what you need to have it take place in your club and what profits it gives you. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/1aee2a5d57c6fc53bdf731b52bb0c8702fb34488.png[/img]

[h3]We are still working on the idea of thematic days 🤔 because we want each of them to have their own unique characteristic bonuses and that brings us to our question, dear players![/h3]

[h3]We can’t wait to hear your ideas! Unfortunately, this brings us to an end of this devlog. If you haven’t already, don’t forget to[b] add our game to your wishlist [/b]👇 and[b] join our discord community [/b]👇 to have an impact on the game’s content.[/h3]

notes.title: Managers and clubs
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Disco enjoyers![/b][/h1]

[b][h3]Welcome to the newest devlog which features 2️⃣ major changes to the game. [/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/74de5a5e01ee747ba46162e0b2952c0b0e8b49a7.png[/img]

Are you a fan of alcohol free dancing parties 🕺💃? Perhaps you enjoy more than a few shots 🥃to elevate your dancing moves to the next level? It doesn’t matter if you prefer a more casual, small club or a big, exclusive place 💎 to spend your Friday night in. Create the club you’ve always dreamt of choosing both a [b]suitable manager[/b] and [b]club localization[/b].

[h2]Starting with [b]the manager[/b], the cornerstone of your club. Each of those skilled individuals has a [b]different set of traits[/b] making every playthrough a [b]truly unique experience[/b]. The right manager can make refurnishing your club less of a struggle, help you make the most 💰 💰 💰 out of every party you throw, or even help you earn more off the bar. 💸
[/h2]

We have provided for several different specializations of club managers to help you achieve certain goals! Among them are : 

[list]
[*] Optimization of costs incurred by your club 💲
[*] Good contacts with furniture companies, allowing you to save a little on the cost of your club’s decoration 🎀
[*] Efficient management of the club, which makes the bartenders give out the ordered drinks faster 🍷
[*] Good contacts with well-known Djs, allowing you to rock the best parties! 💃
[/list]

[h3][b]These are just some of the strengths of Managers available for employment in our game Disco Simulator ✨ 🤯[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/0aa72a9c7aac154f1720885e8e758a3326434892.png[/img]



[h3]As much as in real life, choosing the [b]correct location[/b] for your club is the [b]game changer[/b]. Choose wisely 🦉 because the location dictates what kind of people are more likely to visit your business 🚪🚶. Keep it in mind while creating your [b]business plan[/b] and pick the right manager to [b]complement your strategy[/b] with their traits. [/h3]

[b]Strategize your approach[/b] and make the most out of every single club using their [b]unique characteristics[/b] to your advantage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/585bfba6aad7874e03d4f758acf0e989a0e5fa97.png[/img]



[h3]We pay [b]utmost attention[/b] to your [b]expectations and suggestions[/b] while producing our games so make sure to let us know what [b]features and upgrades[/b] would you like to see in the final products in the comments 👇. Make sure to add our game to your wishlist on steam and click the link below 👇to join our wonderful discord community and keep in touch with both fellow players and devs. [/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Disco Simulator team

Sit back, grab something good to drink and let's get started!  🍕[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/1686b24667912d1051be8cfd29eeb339786e644d.png[/img]

[h2][b]Today we would like to devote more attention to our work of modeling objects for your use in our game  🪑[/b][/h2]

Each club differs in a great many details that give it a unique atmosphere. The more details that are refined and unique, the more willing customers are to return to us 🔄

Therefore, we have spent a lot of time to properly model all sorts of facilities available to you in our [b]Disco Simulator[/b] game! 
We are preparing a lot of furniture for you, in different colors, sizes and styles so that you can customize it according to your needs and your vision of your own club 💃

We start with ordinary, everyday and undistinguished furniture like armchairs or chairs - suitable for combining with extravagant accessories or colorful walls - but we also plan to have amazing and unique [b]objects in neon moods[/b]❗❗

[b]By doing so, we hope to give you more opportunities to express yourselves in our game 🤩 [/b]

[previewyoutube=rawqnFUQzjc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Additional changes and news 🆕[/b][/h2]

🎢 [b]Queuing system[/b] - from now on it is possible to manually set individual items of our customer queues

 👷 [b]The work of our employees can be accelerated[/b]

💭 [b]Customer AI[/b] - we have made some improvements in customer decision making

[h3][b]From the news, we also implemented development points and the mechanics of gaining reputation in the game. But about that, we will tell you in the next devlog ⏭️ [/b][/h3]

[i]Question for the attentive:
What is your favorite song/singer? 🎤[/i]


[b]Traditionally, we also invite you to our Discord, where you can meet players from all over the world, interested in a similar theme of games 👇[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url]

[b]And we encourage you to add our game to your Wishlist to stay up to date with all the news about the Disco Simulator game! ➕ [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226970/Disco_Simulator/


See You soon,
Disco simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Behavior of customers
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Clubbers!  🤩[/b][/h1]

[h3]How are you doing? We hope you are in a "dancing" mood ;) We managed to finish the work we assumed, on one of the most important mechanics occurring in the game - [b]Behavior of customers in your clubs[/b] 🚶[/h3]

[h2]Customers can be found in various ways - those dancing, chilling and arguing at the bar. Our job is to replicate their behavior and way of being as best as possible, to do give you as much fun and a solid dose of realism as possible.[/h2]

[b]Currently we have managed to program behaviors such as:[/b]
💃 Dancing
🚽 Going to the toilet
💺 Resting
🍹 Ordering drinks

[previewyoutube=LK8nphpLH9s;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]From now on, each of the NPCs in our club will live a life of their own![/b]

In addition, in order to improve the functioning of our bartenders, security guards at the entrance and other places where queues of customers tend to form, we came up with a queuing system for our guests!
From now on, every NPC will politely wait for their turn to get a drink!  🍸


[b]Don't forget to add Disco Simulator to your Steam Wishlist and join our server on Discord! 👇[/b]

Disco Simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog#1 - New Team and Building System
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Clubbers!  🤩  [/b][/h1]

[h3]Surely you noticed that recently there have not been many publications about our game [b]Disco Simulator[/b] - It was caused by the change of the team creating the game  🆕 [/h3]

[h3]We are full of positive energy and ready to start a new adventure with the production of our game! Therefore, we will mark devlog as #1[/h3]
[h3]New team - it's a completely new beginning  ❗[/h3]



[h2]In this devlog we want to introduce you to a very large part of the game, which is the system of building and personalizing our [b]club[/b]  🍸[/h2] 

While working on it, we wanted to give you as many opportunities as possible to express yourself and create interiors that will only be limited by your imagination  💭
In addition to building walls, half-walls and floors, which you can freely repaint, you will also have a wide selection of various types of furniture - which will give your club a unique atmosphere.

We also decided to allow you to assign specific roles to individual sectors, thanks to which your guests will have no problem finding what they need most, including - a dance floor  🕺

[b]You can take a look at the mechanics described above in the video below:[/b]

[previewyoutube=bbkcPidadTg;full][/previewyoutube]


As you can see, our [b]new team[/b] is moving forward by storm and will soon be sharing the next steps in developing our [b]Disco Simulator[/b] game with you!  🤜🤛



[h3][b]Share with us your opinion and suggestions regarding the mechanics presented by us in the comments or on our Discord, to which we cordially invite you[/b] 👇 [/h3]


[url=https://discord.gg/bcUDsvbZMy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714194/6dce3866cbd53dadc27b52e7434115225877334e.png[/img][/url]


[h3][b]and remember to add our game to the Steam Wishlist so you don't miss any new information about our game![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226970/Disco_Simulator/

[b]See You soon,
Disco Simulator Team[/b]
